tasks.title: Purge game leaks ('dot', 'virus', 'dotsDelta') from /Server/
tasks.description: Decoupled engine core from Eat 'Em All rules. Replaced hardcoded entity names with generic ECS isTrigger and isStatic flags and generic staticLayers.

tasks.title: Implement 2D Newtonian circle-to-circle impulse solver
tasks.description: Added momentum conservation (m1*v1 + m2*v2 = m1*v1' + m2*v2'), coefficient of restitution (e), Coulomb tangential friction, and inverse-mass separation in SubSystems.js.

tasks.title: Build GameStateMachine & PlayerStateMachine frameworks
tasks.description: Created generic BaseGameState/GameStateMachine in GameState.js and BasePlayerState/PlayerStateMachine in PlayerState.js. Added 3.5s glowing spawn shield.

tasks.title: Implement Reynolds context steering bot AI
tasks.description: Fixed high-frequency bot jitter/vibration. Implemented angular velocity lerping (steerWeight=0.20), target locking (1.2-2.2s), predator evasion (w=2.5), and wall repulsion.

tasks.title: Tune pellet size (3.5px) and area-based mass growth
tasks.description: Reduced pellet radius from 7px to 3.5px. Replaced flat radius += 0.3 with area conservation r = sqrt(r^2 + 2.5) for natural diminishing returns on large blobs.

tasks.title: 10-test automated verification test suite
tasks.description: Created comprehensive unit and integration test suite in tests/test_engine_suite.js validating decoupling, physics momentum, restitution, FSM, and bot steering.

tasks.title: Implement Spacebar cell splitting into projectile halves
tasks.description: Player cell splits into two equal mass halves along cursor heading vector with initial forward boost impulse and 15s recombine timer.

tasks.title: Implement 'W' key mass ejection pellets
tasks.description: Eject small mass pellets (radius ~5px) forward to feed viruses, bait opponents, or quickly shed weight to escape predators.

tasks.title: Autonomous bot tactical split-kill AI
tasks.description: Bots calculate distance to prey and evaluate split feasibility if prey radius < 0.70 * bot radius and no nearby predators threaten split cells.

tasks.title: Migrate to Modular Cartridge Directory and Engine Package
tasks.description: Decomposed monolith into engine/ package (@eatem/engine with server and client runtime) and games/EatEmAll/ cartridge directory with modular entities, systems, and states.

tasks.title: Migrate transport layer from Socket.IO to native Raw WebSockets (ws)
tasks.description: Replaced Socket.IO with native ws library on server and window.WebSocket on client. Implemented single-pass broadcast serialization, achieving 228k msg/sec throughput (6.5x speedup) and sub-millisecond input latency (0.23ms).
